daily_summary: 当日变更聚焦于：KV Connector/KV offload 的正确性修复（SimpleCPUOffload 的 BlockStored 元数据补齐、DecodeBench 对 circular buffer 组填零、offloading scheduler 等待 offload key 到达后再建 store job）、小 batch top-p 采样的 split-row Triton 性能管线（同时改变非 CPU 平台采样分发逻辑）、K2-Horizon 新模型完整支持（模型实现 + 推理/工具解析器 + 注册）、Mamba cache mode 'all' 弃用告警、PLE MTP 元数据异步传输优化、Conformer attention 的 baddbmm 融合、PCP 多节点 world size 校验修复、spec decode 统一 decode 跳过 DP sync、StableLM 开启 torch.compile、Qwen GDN gated RMSNorm 的 JIT warmup，以及 Transformers 5.16.1 测试依赖升级。

commits.comment: 为小 batch（<=64）纯 top-p 采样引入 split-row Triton 管线：将每行按 vocab 切分为 S 个 slice 并行计算 online-softmax 部分量，通过固定轮数的几何阶梯（geometric ladder）pivot 搜索替代整 vocab 扫描，每个 program 冗余重放 combine 链保证确定性，避免小 batch 下 monolithic kernel 的 SM 空闲。同时重写了 apply_top_k_top_p 的分发逻辑：CPU 分支简化，非 CPU 平台不再按 batch>=8 决定是否走 Triton，而是 HAS_TRITON 时一律走 Triton。关键风险点：split 管线只在 logits.device.type=='cuda' 时启用，其 tie-breaking 通过 per-slice 边界值计数实现确定性；monolithic kernel 新增 SPLIT_COVERS_PONLY 标志避免与 split 管线重复处理 p-only 行，并修复 grammar-masked 行（k<vocab 但有限 logits<=k）未被 top-p 覆盖的回归。dispatch 变更意味着所有非 CPU 平台 batch<8 的采样从 PyTorch 切换为 Triton，可能存在平台相关的数值/确定性差异。

ascend_impact.functionality: vllm/v1/sample/ops/topk_topp_sampler.py 的 apply_top_k_top_p 分发逻辑改变：HAS_TRITON 时所有平台（含 Ascend NPU）所有 batch size 统一使用 Triton kernel，移除了原先非 CPU 平台 batch<8 的 PyTorch 路径。vllm-ascend 依赖 Triton，因此 NPU 上的 top-k/top-p 采样将改用 Triton 单体内核；新增的 split 管线被限制为 cuda device type，NPU 不会启用 split 路径。需验证 NPU 上 Triton 单体内核在小 batch（<8）及混合 top-k/top-p 场景下的数值正确性和确定性（tie-breaking）。
ascend_impact.testing: 需要在 NPU 上补充小 batch 采样验证：对比 Triton 内核与 PyTorch 参考实现（apply_top_k_top_p_pytorch）在 batch<8、grammar-masked 行、边界 tie 等场景下结果一致；并确认 SPLIT_COVERS_PONLY=False 路径不会出现 top-p 被跳过的回归。
suggested_test_areas: vllm_ascend 采样集成测试（NPU 小 batch top-k/top-p 与 PyTorch 参考对比）

deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: The commit changes two things relevant to NPU: (1) upstream apply_top_k_top_p in vllm/v1/sample/ops/topk_topp_sampler.py no longer gates the Triton path on batch_size>=8, so on NPU (HAS_TRITON=True) all batch sizes now call apply_top_k_top_p_triton, which vllm-ascend rebinds to apply_top_k_top_p_npu in vllm_ascend/patch/worker/patch_v2/patch_triton.py:45. Small batches (<8) previously went straight to upstream apply_top_k_top_p_pytorch; they now go through apply_top_k_top_p_npu -> _apply_top_k_top_p_pytorch (vllm_ascend/sample/sampler.py). Verify small-batch (top-k only / top-p only / joint) results still match and that performance does not regress vs the old sort path. (2) Guard the enable_reduce_sample tuple contract: _apply_top_k_top_p_pytorch always returns (gathered_vals, gathered_idx) in reduce-sample mode even when called with top_k=None (as apply_top_k_top_p_npu does), whereas upstream apply_top_k_top_p expects a single masked-logits tensor; this can surface in the VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT super().forward_native() fallback (AscendTopKTopPSampler.forward_native in vllm_ascend/sample/sampler.py) and previously only affected batch>=8. Make apply_top_k_top_p_npu return a single tensor (or skip reduce-sample) when invoked from the upstream hook. No work is needed for the new Triton kernel itself: the split-row top-p pipeline (_topp_sb_stats_kernel/_topp_sb_step_kernel/_topp_sb_mask_kernel/_apply_topp_split) is gated on logits.device.type == 'cuda' and the upstream kernel is fully replaced by the patch on NPU, so it never executes there (310P/HAS_TRITON=False is also unaffected since allow_cpu_sync=False matches prior behavior). Optionally port the split-row pipeline to Ascend Triton later to capture the small-batch top-p speedup. Re-run tests/ut/sample/test_sampler.py and small-batch e2e accuracy tests.
deep_analysis.risk: Low. The default NPU sampling path is unaffected because AscendTopKTopPSampler.forward_native overrides upstream and uses the Ascend-local apply_top_k_top_p with an explicit top_k. The change only redirects small-batch calls through the patched hook in non-overridden/batch_invariant paths. Concrete risks: (a) tuple-vs-tensor contract mismatch in enable_reduce_sample mode when apply_top_k_top_p_npu is called from upstream apply_top_k_top_p (experimental feature, narrow combination with VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT, batch<8); (b) behavioral/performance change for small batches on NPU (Ascend sort-based impl ~1ms vs the old upstream path) needs verification; (c) no import/signature breakage of the patch target (apply_top_k_top_p_triton signature unchanged; still called with 3 positional args), and the new SPLIT_COVERS_PONLY constexpr only affects the upstream kernel that is not used on NPU.

commits.comment: 为 Qwen GDN 模型预热 gated RMSNorm Triton kernel。核心重构：将 FLA layernorm_guard.py 中的 layer_norm_fwd_kernel 封装为 LayerNormFwdKernel(VllmJitKernel)，提供 dispatch()/get_warmup_keys()/compile() 的 JIT warmup 生命周期，layer_norm_fwd 改为走该单例；warmup key 覆盖 M 的三种 Triton 整数特化类别 × ROWS_PER_BLOCK 组合，避免运行期 JIT 编译延迟。qwen_triton_warmup 新增 _warm_gated_rms_norm_kernel，从 GDN 层的 norm 模块读取 weight dtype/norm_before_gate/activation 并调用 warmup_layer_norm_fwd。风险点：layer_norm_fwd 的 launch 路径（grid、num_warps、key 缓存）被重构，warmup key 与运行时 dispatch key 必须严格匹配（测试覆盖 rows_per_token∈{1,2,4,8,16} 的所有 num_tokens）。

ascend_impact.functionality: vllm/third_party/flash_linear_attention/ops/layernorm_guard.py 的 layer_norm_fwd 重构为通过 LayerNormFwdKernel 单例分发并接入 VllmJitKernel warmup 机制；vllm/model_executor/warmup/qwen_triton_warmup.py 为 Qwen GDN 层新增 gated RMSNorm 预热调用。vllm-ascend 的 ops 目录包含 GDN 专用算子，若在 NPU 上运行 Qwen GDN/linear-attention 模型将经过该 FLA layernorm Triton kernel；需要确认 warmup_layer_norm_fwd 在 NPU 上不会因 calc_rows_per_block/num_compute_units 的设备行为或 Triton 编译差异而失败，且 warmup key 覆盖 NPU 运行时实际 dispatch key。
ascend_impact.testing: 需在 NPU 上验证 Qwen GDN 模型运行时的 layernorm kernel warmup 与 dispatch key 一致、warmup 调用无异常，并补充 gated RMSNorm 数值正确性测试（参考 rms_norm_ref）。

deep_analysis.adaptation_guide:
Commit 1f76efaa2195 is purely additive (new K2HorizonForCausalLM model file, K2HorizonReasoningParser, K2HorizonToolParser, and registry/reasoning/tool_parsers registration). No shared vLLM interface (Platform, WorkerBase, GPUModelRunner, AttentionBackend, KVCacheSpec) is modified, so nothing in vllm-ascend breaks at import/compile time. However, the model cannot run on NPU without adaptation because its novel MoVA attention path is NPU-incompatible:

1. K2HorizonSparseMoeBlock uses FusedMoEFactory and is therefore already redirected to AscendMoERunner by vllm_ascend/patch/platform/patch_fused_moe.py - the standard MoE layers are fine.
2. K2HorizonMoVAAttention.compute_mova_v_sparse (used for every sparse layer with config.mova_num_experts > 0) calls the module-level fused_mova_impl, which directly invokes vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.fused_moe.dispatch_fused_moe_kernel (vLLM Triton fused-MoE kernels), _prepare_expert_assignment (which calls ops.moe_align_block_size -> torch.ops._moe_C.moe_align_block_size), and ops.moe_sum (-> torch.ops._moe_C.moe_sum). The _moe_C_stable_libtorch extension is only built for CUDA/HIP (CMakeLists.txt lines 175-187 return early for other targets), and vllm-ascend never registers _moe_C, so these calls raise 'operator not found' at runtime. This path is NOT covered by the FusedMoEFactory patch.
3. Required work in vllm-ascend (mirroring how deepseek_v4/minimax_m3/kimi_k3 were added):
   a. Add a worker model patch (vllm_ascend/patch/worker/patch_k2_horizon.py) that replaces K2HorizonMoVAAttention.compute_mova_v_sparse / fused_mova_impl with an implementation built on the existing AscendRoutedExperts-style NPU grouped-matmul + reduction ops (torch.ops._C_ascend grouped_matmul / npu ops) so it does not depend on dispatch_fused_moe_kernel or _moe_C.
   b. Either register NPU fallbacks for torch.ops._moe_C.moe_sum and moe_align_block_size in vllm_ascend/ops/register_custom_ops.py, or route the model around them entirely.
   c. Validate K2HorizonRMSNorm's grouped path (n_groups>1 uses ops.rms_norm per group; n_groups==1 uses the standard RMSNorm path that already runs on NPU) on device.
   d. Verify the Ascend attention backend handles K2-Horizon's attention (split QK rope when rope_head_dim < head_dim, and dual_chunk_attention_config if the checkpoint enables DCA).
   e. The reasoning/tool parsers and the registry entries need no vllm-ascend changes (platform-independent text parsers, keyed by model family from vllm-side registries).
deep_analysis.risk: Medium. If unadapted, serving K2-Horizon on Ascend fails at runtime on the first MoVA sparse layer with a missing-op error (torch.ops._moe_C.moe_sum / moe_align_block_size), since the CUDA-only _moe_C extension is not built for NPU and vllm-ascend has no _moe_C registrations; the vLLM Triton fused-MoE kernels invoked by fused_mova_impl are also not validated on NPU (vllm-ascend intentionally bypasses them via AscendMoERunner). The change is additive so there is no regression risk for already-supported models. Secondary risks: DCA (dual_chunk_attention_config) and Eagle3/Eagle speculative-decode paths are new capabilities requiring Ascend attention-backend and spec-decode validation; the 36B checkpoint size and grouped-RMSNorm behavior should be verified with a full model eval on NPU before claiming support.

commits.comment: 修复 prefix caching + SHM（共享内存）多模态缓存组合下的 EngineCore 崩溃。当 prefix caching 完全覆盖某个多模态 item 的 placeholder 区间时，strip_covered_mm_data() 会丢弃其 payload，导致 SHM receiver 收到 data=None 的 feature 后触发断言。修复包含两部分：(1) strip_covered_mm_data 现在保留 SHM address item（含 "address" 字段的 MultiModalKwargsItem），因为 worker 需要地址来解析 payload 并确认发送方的 writer reference；(2) ShmObjectStoreReceiverCache.get_and_update_features 覆写为先过滤 data=None 的 feature 再调用父类逻辑。新增两个回归测试覆盖该场景。该修复位于平台无关的多模态核心代码，所有平台（含 Ascend）自动继承。

ascend_impact.functionality: 变更位于 vllm/multimodal/cache.py 和 vllm/multimodal/utils.py（平台无关核心代码），命中"可能影响"路径 vllm/multimodal/。vllm-ascend 使用 vLLM 的多模态处理管线，当启用 mm_processor_cache_gb（SHM cache）且同时使用 prefix caching 时，此修复避免了第二次相同请求时 EngineCore 因 data=None 断言而崩溃。vllm-ascend 无需改动代码，自动继承此修复。

vllm_ascend/models/deepseek_v4/model.py::AscendDeepseekV4ForCausalLM — the text backbone (text-only, no SupportsMultiModal/embed_multimodal) that a vision wrapper must wrap; needs a multimodal entry point for the vision variant.

vllm_ascend/models/deepseek_v4/vl_model.py (new) — NPU port of the vision wrapper (vision ViT + aligner + 4 learned sentinel vectors, image_sentinel routing) or a fail-closed stub mirroring upstream vl_stub.py (which rocm/xpu get); can reuse upstream platform-independent vllm/models/deepseek_v4/common/mm_preprocess.py and common/vision.py.

vllm_ascend/attention/dsa_v1.py + dsa_cp.py (AscendDSASWABackend / DSV4 DSA sparse-SWA metadata path) — needs the new prefill_left_visible/prefill_right_visible/max_image_tokens in-image bidirectional visibility fields (added to DeepseekSparseSWAMetadata/Builder and the SWA index/combine kernels in vllm/v1/attention/backends/mla/sparse_swa.py and common/ops/cache_utils.py) for correct prefill SWA indices on image batches.

vllm_ascend/ops/fused_moe (Ascend MoE runner/routing) — upstream added bias_vl + image_sentinel_lo (five in-vocab sentinel ids) to FusedMoEFactory, fused_topk_bias, dsv4_topk and the CUDA topk_softplus_sqrt op; the Ascend MoE router has no such support and needs it to route image sentinel tokens to experts.

vllm_ascend/worker/v2/model_runner.py — build_attention_metadata mm-prefix handling; upstream GPUModelRunner now derives image_doc_ranges from mm_prefix_span_leading_pad_modulus (vision config) for mm-prefix LMs; NPUModelRunnerV2 must stay consistent when running the vision model.
deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: This is a new-multimodal-model support commit (DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp). vllm-ascend must do the following: (1) Register 'DeepseekV4ForConditionalGeneration' in vllm_ascend/models/__init__.py::register_model() — at minimum point it to a stub that raises NotImplementedError (same pattern as upstream vl_stub.py for rocm/xpu) so NPU users fail with a clear message instead of instantiating the NVIDIA wrapper (which resolves its inner language_model to AscendDeepseekV4ForCausalLM via the OOT registry, creating an undefined NVIDIA-wrapper/Ascend-backbone hybrid that is untested and will hit missing CUDA/FlashMLA/FlashInfer/_moe_C.topk_softplus_sqrt ops). (2) For real NPU support: add a new vllm_ascend/models/deepseek_v4/vl_model.py wrapping AscendDeepseekV4ForCausalLM, reusing upstream vllm/models/deepseek_v4/common/mm_preprocess.py (IMAGE_PLACEHOLDER expansion, sentinel block, mm-prefix plumbing: mm_prefix_clamp_sliding_window / mm_prefix_span_leading_pad_modulus=4) and common/vision.py (DeepseekV4ViT/DeepseekV4Aligner), which are pure-PyTorch; add embed_multimodal/SupportsMultiModal and image_sentinel handling to the Ascend text model. (3) Port bias_vl/image_sentinel_lo MoE routing into the Ascend MoE ops (vllm_ascend/ops/fused_moe) since image sentinel tokens must select experts with bias_vl instead of the hash table/e_score_correction_bias. (4) Extend the Ascend DSV4 DSA sparse-SWA attention path (dsa_v1.py/dsa_cp.py) with prefill_left_visible/prefill_right_visible and max_image_tokens so prefill SWA index rows widen bidirectionally inside image spans, matching the upstream kernel semantics. (5) Update the mm-prefix image-span handling in the NPU model runner for the new mm_prefix_span_leading_pad_modulus path. The text-only DeepSeek-V4 path on NPU is not broken: the changed shared modules (DeepseekV4Config vision fields default 0, DeepseekSparseSWAMetadata new fields have defaults, DeepseekV4SWACache unchanged, router/layer.py params additive) are all backward compatible, and vllm-ascend does not consume the changed upstream routers/kernels.
deep_analysis.risk: If vllm-ascend ships without registering DeepseekV4ForConditionalGeneration, serving DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp on NPU will resolve to the NVIDIA vl_model.py (vllm/models/deepseek_v4/__init__.py routes all non-rocm/non-xpu platforms, including Ascend OOT, to the nvidia branch). The wrapper's language_model then resolves to AscendDeepseekV4ForCausalLM through vllm-ascend's own registry, producing an unsupported hybrid that will fail at init/forward on CUDA-only kernels (flash_mla_sparse_fwd, flashinfer, mhc_post_tilelang, torch.ops._moe_C.topk_softplus_sqrt with bias_vl) or give undefined results — a user-facing runtime failure. Existing Ascend DeepseekV4 text inference is unaffected (no signature breaks, new fields defaulted). Main adaptation risk is in the sparse-SWA metadata builder and MoE routing, where incorrect handling of the new in-image visibility fields / bias_vl on NPU would silently produce wrong attention windows or expert routing on the vision variant.
